# Load necessary libraries
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)

# Load data
barcodes <- read.table("barcodes.tsv", colClasses = "character")
genes <- read.table("genes.tsv", colClasses = c("character", "character"))
matrix <- readMM("matrix.mtx")

# Create a Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = matrix, 
                           project = "PBMC", 
                           min.cells = 0, 
                           min.features = 0, 
                           genes = genes[, 2], 
                           cells = barcodes[, 1])

# Calculate the number of detected genes per cell
pbmc@meta.data$n_genes <- Matrix::rowSums(pbmc@assays$RNA@counts > 0)

# Calculate the total UMI counts per cell
pbmc@meta.data$n_UMI <- Matrix::rowSums(pbmc@assays$RNA@counts)

# Identify mitochondrial genes
mito.genes <- grep("^MT-", rownames(pbmc@assays$RNA@counts), value = TRUE)

# Calculate the percentage of mitochondrial genes
pbmc@meta.data$pct_mito <- (Matrix::rowSums(pbmc@assays$RNA@counts[mito.genes, ])) / 
  pbmc@meta.data$n_UMI * 100

# Filter out low-quality cells
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = n_genes > 200 & n_genes < 2500 & n_UMI > 1000 & n_UMI < 20000 & pct_mito < 5)

# Load necessary libraries
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)

# Load data
barcodes <- read.table("barcodes.tsv", colClasses = "character")
genes <- read.table("genes.tsv", colClasses = c("character", "character"))
matrix <- readMM("matrix.mtx")

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = matrix, 
                           project = "PBMC", 
                           min.cells = 3, 
                           min.features = 200)

# Add gene and cell metadata
pbmc@colnames <- barcodes$V1
pbmc@rownames <- genes$V1

# Filter cells and genes
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# Normalize data
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Find variable features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst")

# Scale data
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Run PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Determine significant PCs
pbmc <- JackStraw(pbmc, num.replicate = 100)
pbmc <- ScoreJackStraw(pbmc, dims = 1:20)

# Run UMAP
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

# Run clustering
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# Annotate clusters with known cell type labels
cd4_t_cells <- WhichCells(pbmc, expression = rowMeans(pbmc@assays$RNA@data[rownames(pbmc@assays$RNA@data) %in% c("IL7R", "CCR7"), ]))
cd14_monocytes <- WhichCells(pbmc, expression = rowMeans(pbmc@assays$RNA@data[rownames(pbmc@assays$RNA@data) %in% c("CD14", "LYZ"), ]))
b_cells <- WhichCells(pbmc, expression = rowMeans(pbmc@assays$RNA@data[rownames(pbmc@assays$RNA@data) %in% c("MS4A1"), ]))
cd8_t_cells <- WhichCells(pbmc, expression = rowMeans(pbmc@assays$RNA@data[rownames(pbmc@assays$RNA@data) %in% c("CD8A"), ]))
nk_cells <- WhichCells(pbmc, expression = rowMeans(pbmc@assays$RNA@data[rownames(pbmc@assays$RNA@data) %in% c("GNLY", "NKG7"), ]))

cell_types <- rep("Unknown", ncol(pbmc))
cell_types[cd4_t_cells] <- "CD4 T cells"
cell_types[cd14_monocytes] <- "CD14 Monocytes"
cell_types[b_cells] <- "B cells"
cell_types[cd8_t_cells] <- "CD8 T cells"
cell_types[nk_cells] <- "NK cells"

# Update Seurat object with cell type labels
pbmc@meta.data$cell_type <- cell_types

# Visualize UMAP with cell type labels
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", group.by = "cell_type")

# Load necessary libraries
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(ggplot2)

# Load data
barcodes <- read.table("barcodes.tsv", colClasses = "character")
genes <- read.table("genes.tsv", colClasses = c("character", "character"))
matrix <- readMM("matrix.mtx")

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = matrix, rownames = genes[, 2], colnames = barcodes[, 1])

# Filter cells and genes
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & nCount_RNA > 1000)
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 0)

# Normalize data
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Find variable features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst")

# Scale data
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Run PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Determine significant PCs
elbow_point <- WhichDimShouldIUse(pbmc, dims = 1:15)
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:elbow_point)

# Find clusters
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:elbow_point)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# Define marker genes for each cell type
marker_genes <- list(
  CD4_T = c("IL7R", "CCR7"),
  CD14_Monocytes = c("CD14", "LYZ"),
  B_cells = c("MS4A1"),
  CD8_T = c("CD8A"),
  NK_cells = c("GNLY", "NKG7")
)

# Annotate clusters with cell type labels
cell_type <- rep(NA, nrow(pbmc@meta.data))
for (i in 1:ncol(pbmc@meta.data)) {
  cluster_cells <- pbmc@meta.data[i, ]
  for (cell_type_name in names(marker_genes)) {
    marker_expression <- rowMeans(pbmc@assays$RNA@data[which(genes[, 2] %in% marker_genes[[cell_type_name]]), cluster_cells])
    if (mean(marker_expression) > 0.5) {
      cell_type[cluster_cells] <- cell_type_name
    }
  }
}

# Add cell type labels to Seurat object
pbmc@meta.data$cell_type <- cell_type

# Visualize UMAP with cell type labels
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", group.by = "cell_type", cols = "coolwarm")

pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst")

# Scale data
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Run PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Determine significant PCs
pbmc <- JackStraw(pbmc, num.replicate = 100)
pbmc <- ScoreJackStraw(pbmc, dims = 1:20)
elbow <- WhichDimAreSignificant(pbmc, dims = 1:20)
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:elbow)

# Find clusters
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:elbow)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# Define marker genes for each cell type
marker_genes <- list(
  CD4_T = c("IL7R", "CCR7"),
  CD14_Monocytes = c("CD14", "LYZ"),
  B_cells = c("MS4A1"),
  CD8_T = c("CD8A"),
  NK_cells = c("GNLY", "NKG7")
)

# Find markers for each cluster
cluster_markers <- FindAllMarkers(pbmc, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)

# Annotate clusters with cell type labels
cell_type_labels <- sapply(1:pbmc@meta.data$seurat_clusters, function(x) {
  cluster_marker <- cluster_markers %>% filter(cluster == x)
  max_score <- 0
  cell_type <- NA
  for (cell_type in names(marker_genes)) {
    score <- sum(cluster_marker %>% filter(gene %in% marker_genes[[cell_type]]) %>% pull(p_val_adj))
    if (score > max_score) {
      max_score <- score
      cell_type <- cell_type
    }
  }
  return(cell_type)
})

# Add cell type labels to Seurat object
pbmc@meta.data$cell_type <- cell_type_labels[pbmc@meta.data$seurat_clusters]

# Visualize UMAP with cell type labels
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", group.by = "cell_type")

library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(ggplot2)

# Load data
barcodes <- read.table("barcodes.tsv", colClasses = "character")
genes <- read.table("genes.tsv", colClasses = c("character", "character"))
matrix <- readMM("matrix.mtx")

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = matrix, project = "PBMC", genes = genes[, 2], cells = barcodes[, 1])

# Filter cells and genes
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# Normalize data
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Scale data
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = rownames(pbmc))

# Perform PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Determine significant PCs
elbow <- InflectionPoint(pbmc@reductions$pca@stddev, type = "elbow")
pbmc <- JackStraw(pbmc, num.replicate = 100)
pbmc <- ScoreJackStraw(pbmc, dims = 1:elbow)

# Run UMAP
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:elbow)

# Run clustering
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:elbow)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# Perform differential expression analysis
cluster0 <- subset(pbmc, idents = 0)
cluster3 <- subset(pbmc, idents = 3)
de_res <- FindMarkers(cluster0, cluster3, only.pos = FALSE)

# Create volcano plot
volcano_data <- data.frame(log2FC = de_res$avg_logFC, p_val_adj = de_res$p_val_adj)
volcano_data$significant <- ifelse(abs(volcano_data$log2FC) > 1 & volcano_data$p_val_adj < 0.05, "yes", "no")

ggplot(volcano_data, aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(p_val_adj), color = significant)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "red")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "log2 Fold Change", y = "-log10 Adjusted p-value")
